name: repair
title: rosync repair
description: Checks live tree access and rebuilds generated Ro Sync metadata.
usage:
rosync repair tree [--project <path>] [--port <port>] [--depth <n>] [--raw]
rosync repair sourcemap [--project <path>] [--output <path>] [--raw]
notes: `repair tree` validates that the live Studio tree can be read; use `rosync tree` or `rosync query` to inspect it.
`repair sourcemap` rebuilds luau-lsp sourcemap JSON from synced service folders.
